products.long_description:
A lion face meets the eye first. Electric blue, cadmium red, acid yellow, hot pink, and forest green sit against pure black with no shadow to soften the arrival. The color does not decorate the animal. It governs the room.

In Buganda tradition, the lion is not only wildness. It is authority, the Kabaka, the one who does not need to announce himself twice. Majestic Monarch belongs to that line: power rendered flat, direct, and without apology.

This piece needs space. Choose A2 and above when the wall can carry it, especially above a sofa, console, or desk where the lion can hold the room on its own terms.
